overview: The commission received a presentation from the Massachusetts Human Rights Coalition and coordinated logistics for upcoming events commemorating Martin Luther King Jr. Day, Lunar New Year, and Belinda Sutton. A proposal to issue a public statement regarding the Israel-Gaza conflict was deferred pending legal review of the commission's authority.

items.title: Guest Presentation: Massachusetts Human Rights Coalition
items.summary: Adam LaFrance provided an overview of the coalition's history and resources while offering guidance on commission recruitment and municipal structure.

items.title: Martin Luther King Jr. Day Planning
items.summary: Commissioners volunteered to provide logistical support and an educational presentation for the West Medford Community Center’s event on January 15.

items.title: Inaugural Lunar New Year Celebration
items.summary: The commission planned a cultural event for February 10 at the Medford Public Library featuring a lion dance and youth participation.

items.title: Belinda Sutton Petition Reading
items.summary: Members scheduled the annual commemorative event for February 17 at the Royal House and Slave Quarters.

items.title: Authority to Issue Public Statements
items.summary: A proposal to issue a statement regarding the Israel-Gaza conflict was deferred to the January meeting. The Director stated that legal counsel must first clarify the commission's parameters for speaking on behalf of the city under existing ordinances.
